artifact: Issue #9 M4-3 regression ownership and handoff map
positive_test_rule: Ingress-positive authorization cases must use CapabilityLeaseIssuer.issue from valid TrustedMutationAuthorization; fixture-made leases are negative or lifecycle-only evidence, not ingress acceptance evidence.

known_non_blocking_baseline_finding.cause: The lifecycle portion of these cases replaces a real issued lease with make_test_lease; the accepted exact-binding repair correctly denies that unbound fixture lease.
known_non_blocking_baseline_finding.acceptance_status: non-acceptance evidence; do not repair during M4-3 planning
known_non_blocking_baseline_finding.required_future_action: Add ingress-positive cases that preserve the real CapabilityLeaseIssuer-issued lease and keep fixture-only cases explicitly labeled.

entries.scenario: Existing read-only execute routes and envelopes remain unchanged after lifecycle registration.
Unknown operations fail before handler execution.
Read-only operations cannot enter execute_mutation and write operations cannot enter the read-only route.
Plain principal, lease, internal ID, raw path, and unknown trusted fields are rejected.
Wrong operation, target, scope, contract hash, or intent fingerprint is rejected before lifecycle mutation.
Missing, malformed, or wrong-kind semantic evidence cannot produce a positive ingress lease.
entries.behavioral_proof_stage: M4-2 source plus M4-3 real-lease integration

entries.scenario: Expired, revoked, consumed, or outcome-unknown leases fail closed.
A valid real lease and exact Project Binding produce one isolated PLAN_INIT effect.
Zero or many project candidates never become an automatic binding.
Already initialized plans return bounded no-effect reentry results.
An exact selected snapshot and real lease retire abandoned or superseded plans only under fresh checks.
Zero/many candidates and missing explicit kind preserve semantic choice without mutation.
Active/current and running-task plans are protected.
Self, missing, heuristic, stale, or changed successors fail closed.
Subject CAS, raw authority precondition, and normalized digest remain separate domains.
Same intent replays and changed intent conflicts without duplicate effect.
No-effect, semantic-choice, blocked, conflict, unknown, and verified effects remain distinct.
PLAN_INIT reentry remains denied.

entries.ownership: M4-4 retirement with later authority integration
entries.scenario: Retirement choice, protection, snapshot, successor, and no-resurrection rules remain closed.
Post-binding producer-consumer reentry cannot create a new semantic effect.
Unknown external outcomes reconcile before any new lease or write; M4-3 supplies no recovery runtime.
No external authority, GitHub, journal, or production graph write is claimed by M4-3.

downstream_rule: Planning and ingress design closure are not behavioral closure and do not authorize source implementation, runtime activation, or external mutation.
